title: Declarative English feature-profile acceptability analysis
independentExamples: Agreement and valency over nonce nouns and predicates
Binding, polarity licensing, and filler-gap constraints under open-class renaming
preconditions: all executable behavior remains trusted source code
invariants: no case IDs, labels, source sentences, or paradigm keys in the generic core
pair reversal reverses a non-tied preference
uncertaintySemantics: Ambiguous or unsupported analyses produce a tie or fewer violations; they do not invent lexical facts.
proofBehavior: Every penalty is represented by a typed violation with its family and controller/target offsets.
resourceBounds: Finite token scan, finite declarative lexeme lookup, no network, no subprocess, and no recursion over source content.
kbMigration: No runtime KB migration; development evidence compiles into a separate declarative feature profile.
